components.scope: component, store, host-unit, wire and CLI: operational store migration 22 and the kernel run action history store (append-only records, forward-only heads, replay at every read and store open, owner and closed rules, retention of closed chains); persisted host recorders for the effects, job control and route chains, with the route entry stored before any model is built and chains closed when an ended run's session is dropped; IPC wire 11 reads an ended run's stored histories while no run is held; the CLI's --ended-run view and export and the harness ended-run subcommand; the factory's composition glue runs only in native composition, which this sandbox refuses, so no actual process stored or read a history here

mutation_checks: run before the source commit with private tooling, each applying one exact replacement and running the package filter: 17 single mutations over the kernel store's owner, closed, bound, named-head, canonical-encoding, expired-flag, retention and attach rules and its verification at store open (9), and the host's persisted append and mark, restart marking, closing, held-run refusal, ended-run verification and job control persistence (8); 16 made their expected test fail at once. The survivor removed the explicit close at release, which was redundant because releasing drops the ended session, whose drop closes its chains; the explicit close was removed, the drop rule was mutated instead, and the rerun caught it. These runs are not retained logs
